responsibility: This file implements the SARIF replay library that reads SARIF JSON and re-emits its findings through `libgdiagnostics`. It owns file reading, JSON parsing, SARIF schema/property validation, mapping of SARIF artifacts, regions, rules, logical locations, annotations, fixes, and related objects onto `libgdiagnostics` files, locations, diagnostics, labels, and fix-it hints, and it reports malformed or unsupported input with control diagnostics that can reference SARIF specification sections via generated URL anchors. It is the main executable engine behind replaying saved SARIF results as GCC-style diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Contains the SARIF replay engine implementation: file reading, JSON/SARIF validation, object mapping, diagnostics emission, and the `sarif_replay_path` function body. In this same-name pair, the .h is just the public C API declaration and options struct for clients.
